note: Authored allergy groups with a source (PLAN F3, I4). An allergy on the profile matches a group by its id or one of its aliases; the flag fires only for a listed member. Keys are `allergy:<group>|<ingredient>`. An allergy written as a listed member's own name (e.g. `amoxicillin`) matches that ingredient only, key `allergy:<ingredient>|<ingredient>`, and never the rest of its group. Nothing is inferred across groups: no penicillin -> cephalosporin cross-reactivity, and no sulfonamide antibiotic -> non-antibiotic sulfonamide (furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide, celecoxib). Allergy flags stay on the device (the allergy list is a personal field; B's generalize sends nothing for engine `allergy`).

rules.source: FDA labeling for penicillin-class antibiotics (e.g. amoxicillin): contraindicated with a history of serious hypersensitivity to any penicillin
rules.text: Your record lists a penicillin allergy and this medicine is a penicillin. Tell the pharmacist or prescriber about the allergy before taking it.

rules.source: FDA labeling for sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim: contraindicated with known hypersensitivity to sulfonamides
rules.text: Your record lists a sulfa allergy and this medicine is a sulfonamide antibiotic. Tell the pharmacist or prescriber about the allergy before taking it.
